items.text: VLSI and semiconductor careers cover chip design, verification, physical design, testing and manufacturing support, and you can show readiness with a small digital design and testbench, a clear grasp of digital logic and a project in a free toolchain.
Strong digital fundamentals and one complete design-and-verify project matter more than a long list of tool certificates.
Read notices, ask engineers in the field and check programme outcomes before paying fees.
